materiality: The ROCm DeepSeek-V4 sparse indexer can route incompatible KV-cache layouts through the wrong logits path on gfx950/gfx942, collapsing sparse-indexer logits instead of preserving the model's retrieval distribution.
The successor distinguishes block-flat C4A from 16x16 shuffle layouts and adds Triton-versus-eager reference checks, but upstream parity is not an SZL qualification receipt.
requiredEvidence: Bind the exact vLLM source/container, exact admitted DeepSeek-V4/V4.1 artifact and config, ROCm/HIP/AITER/Triton/Torch versions, gfx942 or gfx950 accelerator identity, page/block size, compression ratio and TP/EP topology.

Run the immediate predecessor as a known-bad control on an affected accelerator and preserve the failing logits/top-k receipt; if affected hardware is unavailable, record UNAVAILABLE rather than substituting CUDA or CPU evidence.

Exercise compression ratios 1, 2 and 4, block-flat versus shuffle cache layouts, page boundaries, short and long sequence lengths and graph/eager paths; compare valid-position logits and resulting top-k against an independently executed eager reference.
Require finite logits, no silent layout coercion, deterministic rollback to the incumbent backend and failure/cancellation cleanup before any throughput claim.

materiality: Triton speculative verification previously derived attention widths from configured draft counts even when the runtime verification width differed, so qo-indptr, masks, KV extents and sliding-window metadata could disagree with the actual verification step.
The successor resolves num_tokens_per_req from runtime SpecInput metadata and carries that width through eager and CUDA-graph verification metadata.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact SGLang source/image, model and speculative algorithm, draft model/revision, tokenizer, Triton/CUDA or supported accelerator stack, capture width, runtime num_tokens_per_req and draft_token_num.

Use predecessor negative controls where configured and runtime widths differ, including gamma versus gamma+1 verification, then prove candidate qo-indptr, mask-indptr, max-extend and KV-index extents match the executed token count.

Exercise EAGLE-family verification, custom-mask present/absent, sliding-window attention, eager and CUDA-graph replay, variable batch sizes, cancellation/restart and invalid/nonpositive runtime-width fallback.
Compare accepted-token/output parity with a non-speculative or independently qualified reference before latency or acceptance-rate claims; preserve an opt-out rollback.

materiality: Tiered KV offloading now adds latency-derived back-pressure detection, drop/throttle policies, idle recovery and per-tier configuration inheritance; these controls directly affect whether cache stores are retained, deferred or dropped under sustained pressure.

The successor explicitly rejects the generic latency detector for P2P because that signal cannot safely fail fast there, so backend-specific refusal is part of the correctness contract rather than an optional optimization.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact vLLM source/image, offload tier type and locality, KV block geometry, transport, storage endpoint, detector/policy configuration, host memory, accelerator and concurrency settings.

Run deterministic slow-tier pressure, burst, idle-decay and recovery scenarios with known block identities; prove no dropped store is later advertised as durable/available and no load returns stale or foreign KV data.

Exercise field-by-field configuration inheritance, high/low watermark hysteresis, warmup, accounting-only and drop/throttle policies, queue drain, cancellation, restart and process failure; record all drop decisions and recovery transitions.
Require P2P to refuse unsupported detector configuration exactly as designed; retain the existing offload path as rollback and measure performance only after cache correctness.

materiality: The router now distinguishes upstream 429/503 capacity backpressure from genuine breaker faults, preventing a saturated but responsive worker from opening the circuit and fleet-wide false shedding.

The upstream contract intentionally does not detect a worker that returns 503 indefinitely, so chronic backpressure must remain visible to a separate health signal instead of being silently treated as healthy forever.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact router source/image and worker source, routing policy, breaker threshold/cooldown, stream/non-stream endpoint, replica count and load profile.

Use deterministic sequences mixing 2xx, 429, 503, 500, 502, 504, transport timeout and mid-stream body failure; prove only genuine faults advance the breaker while 429/503 resolve half-open probes without erasing a closed-state real-failure streak.

Add a chronic-429/503 control proving a separate higher-level health/pressure signal surfaces and can demote or alarm on a persistently unavailable worker; do not reinterpret neutral breaker accounting as worker health.

Exercise concurrent late completions, half-open probe races, streaming cancellation/restart and single-worker/fleet routing; preserve incumbent breaker semantics as rollback until failure-injection receipts pass.

materiality: TRL replaces full-logit materialization in GRPO/KTO scoring with a streamed selective log-probability projection designed to bound peak [tokens,vocab] memory while preserving loss inputs.

The new path directly executes the backbone and therefore carries explicit mixed-precision, gradient, all-masked and chunk-boundary correctness obligations that cannot inherit from earlier AsyncGRPO or KTO-Liger waves.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact TRL/Transformers/PEFT/Torch/Liger revisions, model and tokenizer artifact digests, dtype/autocast mode, optimizer, batch/sequence/vocab sizes and accelerator topology.

Compare streamed versus full-logit per-token log-probabilities, entropies, losses, gradients and optimizer updates on deterministic fixtures across at least one token-chunk boundary; preserve full-logit output as the reference receipt.

Exercise BF16/FP16 autocast, sequence/token importance sampling, masked and fully masked completions, empty-valid-row differentiability, gradient accumulation, DDP/FSDP where actually supported and cancellation/restart/checkpoint-resume.
Measure peak memory and throughput only after numerical/training parity is within declared tolerances; no quality improvement claim and no training-default promotion from memory savings alone.

materiality: Trainer special-token alignment read and wrote the top-level config even for composite multimodal models whose BOS/EOS/PAD identities live on the text sub-config, causing false mismatch warnings and writing token IDs onto the wrong configuration surface.
The successor routes alignment through get_text_config(), retaining text-only behavior while making composite-model token identity explicit.
requiredEvidence: Bind exact Transformers source, composite model/revision, processor/tokenizer/revision and generation config; include at least one Llava-like image-text model plus a text-only control.

Run the predecessor as a negative control and demonstrate the false top-level mismatch/write without mutating production artifacts; then prove the candidate updates or preserves BOS/EOS/PAD only on the canonical text config and expected generation config.

Exercise unchanged-token and changed-token cases, multiple EOS handling, save/reload round trips, generation after alignment and processor/tokenizer mismatch cases; fail closed on ambiguous composite text configuration.
Do not infer multimodal model quality from configuration alignment and do not publish a new checkpoint merely to inventory the fix.
